overview: The Medford City Council Committee of the Whole met to discuss the Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) Annual Action Plan for Fiscal Year 2027. The committee heard presentations from various local public service agencies applying for funding and voted to refer the plan to the regular City Council meeting.

items.title: Community Development Block Grant Action Plan for Fiscal Year 2027 (Item 26-074)
items.summary: The committee reviewed the proposed allocation of approximately $1.733 million in CDBG funds and heard program updates from nine local public service organizations. The committee voted to refer the action plan to the May 12, 2026, regular meeting.
